task.description: REWORK #2 of step-02a: fix the two BLOCKERs surfaced by SECURITY-REVIEWER. (1) Wire the validation_routes.handleValidate call into src/main.zig's serveRequest under the existing 'definitions' resource block (alongside handleActivate/handleDeprecate/handleArchive/handleExport). (2) Extend handleValidate to accept tenant_id from AuthContext and thread it to store.getById so cross-tenant reads cannot succeed.

fix_1_wire_route.what: Add a routing branch under the existing 'definitions' resource block. Look at the pattern for handleActivate/handleDeprecate/handleArchive/handleExport - they branch on seg5 (e.g. 'activate', 'deprecate', etc.). Add a branch that calls validation_routes.handleValidate when method == .POST && std.mem.eql(u8, seg5, 'validate'). Pass through the auth context (auth_ctx) and tenant_id, plus the def_store, req_alloc, and seg4 (definition id).
fix_1_wire_route.example_pattern: Look at lines around the existing handleActivate handler dispatch in src/main.zig (search for 'activate' or 'deprecate' to find the block). Mirror that exact pattern.

fix_2_tenant_id.what: Change the function signature to accept tenant_id (or AuthContext containing tenant_id). Thread it to store.getById - either call a tenant-scoped variant getByIdForTenant(tenant_id, id) or set the ambient tenant context on the pool before reading. Either way, cross-tenant reads must fail with 404/403 (not 200 with wrong tenant's data).

result.summary: Both SECURITY-REVIEWER BLOCKERs fixed. (1) src/main.zig serveRequest now dispatches seg5=='validate' on POST to validation_routes.handleValidate alongside handleActivate/handleDeprecate/handleArchive/handleExport (the endpoint was unreachable before - import existed but no dispatch branch called it). (2) handleValidate signature extended to accept tenant_id:[36]u8 from the authenticated AuthContext; the handler pins the ambient tenant context via api_tenant_context.set + defer clear for the duration of store.getById, giving defence in depth on top of the FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY policy on process_definitions - cross-tenant reads fall through as DefinitionNotFound (HTTP 404). zig build exit 0; 0 new lint errors; pre-existing test compile failures unchanged from baseline (out of rework scope per attempt #2 handoff).

fixes.description: Added POST /api/v1/definitions/:id/validate dispatch branch in the 'definitions' resource block (serveRequest). Reads tenant_id from authenticated_ctx.tenant_id (falls back to api_auth.DEFAULT_TENANT_ID for unauthenticated paths), passes it to validation_routes.handleValidate(def_store, req_alloc, tenant_id, seg4).

Extended handleValidate signature with tenant_id:[36]u8 parameter. Before calling store.getById, the handler calls api_tenant_context.set(tenant_id) + defer api_tenant_context.clear() to pin the ambient tenant context for the DB read - defence in depth on top of the process_definitions RLS policy (migrations/028_adp02_tenant_scope_persistence.sql). Cross-tenant reads return 404, not 200.
